name: Hanscom AFB
description: Headquarters of the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center and a major electronics systems acquisition hub in the Boston metro area. A predominantly civilian and contractor workforce supporting C3I and cyber programs — no flightline operations or traditional DFAC.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center or Sartain Gate after hours.

gates.name: Sartain Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate on Hanscom Drive. Visitor passes available here when VCC is closed (up to next duty day). After 2200, Exit 31B is the only gate open per official directions.
gates.address: Sartain Gate, Hanscom Dr, Bedford, MA 01731

gates.name: Ruiz Gate (Hartwell Ave)
gates.notes: Open daily 0530-2200 except federal holidays per hanscom.af.mil. Formerly Hartwell Gate. Note: hanscomhousing.com lists 24/7 — verify current hours before travel.
gates.address: Ruiz Gate, Hartwell Ave, Lexington, MA 02421

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Sartain Gate)
gates.notes: Closed weekends and federal holidays. Sponsors can obtain visitor passes for up to 60 days. AFMC family days: 0600-1400. REAL ID required.
gates.address: Bldg 1617, Sartain Gate, Hanscom Dr, Bedford, MA 01731

resources.name: No Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Hanscom AFB has no traditional military dining facility. Unaccompanied housing residents receive BAS. Use Conference Center catering, BX food court, Minuteman Commons lunch, or off-base restaurants in Bedford, Lexington, and Boston.
resources.hours: N/A — no DFAC on installation

resources.name: Hanscom Conference Center Dining
resources.description: Conference and event catering — primary on-base meal service for meetings, official functions, and group dining. Not a substitute for a full DFAC.
resources.hours: Event-based catering; call 781-225-6165 for schedules

resources.name: BX Food Court
resources.description: Primary daily dining on base — Subway, Dunkin', Froots, Energy Plus Nutrition, Sunny's Happy Bowl, and micro markets. No formal DFAC available.
resources.hours: Mon-Sat 0600-1900; Sun 1100-1700 (Subway, Dunkin, Froots, and other vendors)
resources.address: 100 Eglin St, Bldg 1709B, Hanscom AFB, MA 01731

resources.name: Minuteman Commons (Lunch & Tavern)
resources.description: Community center with limited lunch Tue-Fri and The Tavern bar Wed-Sat evenings. Pizza takeout and delivery available select days.
resources.hours: Center Mon-Thu 0800-1900, Fri 0800-2200, Sat 0900-1500; Lunch Tue-Fri 1100-1330

resources.name: Hanscom Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service BX with clothing, electronics, food court, barber, optical, GNC, dry cleaning, and services. Primary on-base retail for this acquisition installation.
resources.hours: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM-7:00 PM; Sun 11:00 AM-5:00 PM
resources.address: 100 Eglin St, Bldg 1709B, Hanscom AFB, MA 01731

resources.name: Nearest Commissary (Off-Base)
resources.description: No commissary on Hanscom AFB. Nearest Defense Commissary Agency groceries are at Fort Devens, MA and other regional installations — plan trips for major grocery shopping.
resources.hours: Fort Devens Commissary (off-base): Sun 10:00 AM-6:00 PM; Mon-Sat 9:00 AM-7:00 PM
resources.address: Fort Devens, MA 01434 (off-base, nearest regional commissary)

resources.name: 66th Medical Squadron Clinic
resources.description: Outpatient MTF — family medicine, pediatrics, flight medicine, behavioral health, dental, optometry, pharmacy, lab, and immunizations. No emergency department on base.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed Wed 0730-1000 for medical readiness training
resources.address: 90 Vandenberg Dr, Bldg 1900, Hanscom AFB, MA 01731

resources.name: Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: 50,000 sq ft facility with indoor track, gymnasiums, racquetball, rock-climbing wall, group exercise, and family workout area. 24/7 CAC access after registration.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0600-1800; 24/7 CAC access to cardio, weights, track, and locker rooms after registration
resources.address: 180 Marrett St, Bldg 1548, Hanscom AFB, MA 01731

resources.name: Hanscom Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base credit union with deposit accounts, loans, and ATM services for military and DoD community members.

resources.name: Local Banks & Credit Unions
resources.description: Off-base banking options in Bedford, Lexington, Burlington, and the greater Boston area supplement on-base Hanscom FCU.
resources.hours: Off-base institution hours in Bedford, Lexington, and Boston metro
resources.address: Bedford, Lexington, and Boston metro, MA

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service for 66 ABW personnel.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Appointment-based via RAPIDS.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; RAPIDS appointments for ID cards

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, financial readiness, newcomers briefing, employment assistance, school liaison, and family programs.

resources.name: 66th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — fitness, recreation, lodging, community events, and family support for this small acquisition base.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours at hanscomfss.com

resources.name: Hanscom Housing (Privatized)
resources.description: Limited on-base privatized family housing managed by Balfour Beatty. Off-base housing is common in Bedford, Lexington, Burlington, and Concord. Visit HMO before signing any lease.

resources.name: Hanscom Inn (Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging for PCS and TDY. Up to 30 days for inbound PCS; pet-friendly rooms available. Advance reservations recommended.
resources.hours: Front desk during business hours; check official site for check-in times

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing (Dorms)
resources.description: Single rooms with shared bath for E-1 to E-4. No DFAC on base — dorm residents receive BAS and have kitchen facilities. No pets permitted.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rentals, camping gear, seasonal recreation programs, and adventure trips. Check FSS for Fourth Cliff Recreation Area (Scituate, MA) availability.

resources.name: Local Golf (No On-Base Course)
resources.description: No golf course on Hanscom AFB. Area courses in Bedford, Lexington, and the Boston metro serve the local military community — check ODR for possible discounts.
resources.hours: Off-base course hours; contact ODR for discount programs
resources.address: Bedford, Lexington, and Boston metro, MA

resources.name: Local Bowling (No On-Base Alley)
resources.description: No bowling alley on Hanscom AFB. Off-base bowling centers in Bedford, Burlington, and the surrounding communities serve personnel and families.
resources.hours: Off-base facility hours in Bedford and Burlington, MA

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access at Sartain Gate. All visitors require a pass — REAL ID required. Passes available at Sartain Gate after VCC hours.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1600; closed weekends and federal holidays
resources.address: Bldg 1617, Sartain Gate, Hanscom Dr, Bedford, MA 01731

resources.name: 66th Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense, law enforcement, and gate operations for Hanscom AFB.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement. DoD civilians should confirm in-processing with their gaining organization.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) or gaining organization normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit MPF and Finance as directed by your unit.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: On-base privatized housing is limited — most families live off-base in Bedford, Lexington, Burlington, and Concord. Contact Hanscom Housing before arrival. Hanscom Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access & Limited Base Services
sections.body: Sartain Gate is open 24/7. Ruiz Gate (Hartwell Ave) is 0530-2200 daily except federal holidays per hanscom.af.mil — note hanscomhousing.com lists 24/7; verify before travel. VCC: Mon-Fri 0600-1600. This is a small acquisition base with no DFAC, no commissary, and no on-base golf or bowling. Dining via Conference Center, BX food court, and off-base options.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource for relocation support. Hanscom supports AFLCMC and electronics systems acquisition — expect a civilian-heavy workforce.
